title: 第87章 我不想跟他过了

第87章 我不想跟他过了-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

周五那天。

王超早上出门时说晚上可能晚点回来，同事约了吃饭。

林美丽说：“那你早点回来，别喝酒。”

王超随口应了一声就走了。

结果到了夜里十二点，人还没回来。

林美丽坐在炕上等，等到一点，等到两点。

实在熬不住了，和衣躺下，迷迷糊糊睡了一会儿，被开门声惊醒。

王超回来了。

满身酒气，走路都打晃，撞翻了门口的洗脸盆架，咣当一声响。

林美丽惊醒，猛地坐起来，看了看墙上的钟。

凌晨三点二十。

“王超，你说晚点回来，这是晚点？三点多了！”

王超没理她，歪在炕沿上脱鞋，脱了半天没脱下来。

“你去哪了？是不是又打牌了？”

“你管得着吗？”王超含混不清地嘟囔了一句。

林美丽下了炕，走到他跟前，闻到他身上的酒味和烟味，还有一股说不清的脂粉气。

她的血一下子涌上了头顶。

“王超，你说清楚，你到底去哪了？”

“说了你也不认识。”

“我是你媳妇！我问你去哪了！”

王超被她嚷得烦了，站起来想往炕上爬。

林美丽一把拽住他的袖子：“你今天不说清楚，别想睡！”

“你烦不烦！”

王超猛地甩开她的手。

他力气大，又喝了酒没收着劲。

林美丽被甩得往后趔趄了两步，后腰结结实实撞在桌沿上。

不是肚子的疼，是后腰，骨头撞在硬木上的那种疼。

但疼得她眼前一黑，整个人蹲了下去。

王超也愣了一下，酒醒了一半。

他想伸手扶她，但手伸到一半又缩回去了。

林美丽蹲在地上，慢慢抬起头，看着他。

眼眶里全是泪，但没有掉下来。

“王超你这个混蛋！”

她忽然像发了疯一样，猛地站起来朝王超扑过去，十根手指朝他脸上抓。

王超猝不及防，脸上被抓出两道血印子。

他疼得倒吸一口气，本能地一把攥住林美丽的两只手，把她整个人禁锢住。

林美丽拼命挣扎，指甲在他的手背上又抓又掐。

王超吃痛，火气蹭地窜上来。

他腾出一只手，一巴掌扇在她脸上。

林美丽被打得偏过头去，耳朵嗡的一声。

没等她反应过来，第二巴掌又落下来了。

然后是第三巴掌。

Friday.

When Wang Chao went out in the morning, he said he might come back later in the evening, and his colleagues made an appointment for dinner.

Lin Meili said: "Then come back early and don't drink."

Wang Chao responded casually and left.

As a result, at twelve o'clock at night, no one came back.

Lin Meili sat on the kang and waited until one o'clock, then two o'clock.

I couldn't stand it any longer, so I lay down with my clothes on and fell asleep for a while, but was awakened by the sound of the door opening.

Wang Chao is back.

He smelled of alcohol, staggered when he walked, and knocked over the washbasin stand at the door, making a loud clang.

Lin Meili woke up with a start, sat up suddenly, and looked at the clock on the wall.

Three twenty in the morning.

"Wang Chao, you said you would come back later. Is this late? It's past three o'clock!"

Wang Chao ignored her and leaned on the edge of the kang to take off his shoes. He took them off for a long time without taking them off.

"Where have you been? Are you playing cards again?"

"Do you care?" Wang Chao muttered vaguely.

Lin Meili got off the kang and walked up to him. She smelled the smell of alcohol and cigarettes on him, as well as an indescribable smell of powder.

Her blood suddenly surged to the top of her head.

"Wang Chao, tell me clearly, where have you been?"

"You don't know me even if you tell me."

"I'm your wife! I asked you where you were!"

Wang Chao was annoyed by her shouting and stood up to climb onto the kang.

Lin Meili grabbed his sleeve: "If you don't explain clearly today, don't even think about sleeping!"

"Are you annoyed?"

Wang Chao slammed her hand away.

He was very strong, but he drank and drank to lose his strength.

Lin Meili was thrown back and staggered two steps, and her lower back hit the edge of the table firmly.

It's not a pain in my stomach, it's a pain in my lower back, the kind of pain where my bones hit the hard wood.

But the pain was so painful that her vision went dark and she squatted down.

Wang Chao was also stunned for a moment, half sober from the wine.

He wanted to reach out to help her, but he retracted his hand halfway.

Lin Meili squatted on the ground, slowly raised her head and looked at him.

His eyes were full of tears, but they didn't fall.

"Wang Chao, you bastard!"

She suddenly stood up and rushed toward Wang Chao like she was going crazy, scratching his face with ten fingers.

Wang Chao was caught off guard and had two bloody marks on his face.

He gasped in pain and instinctively grabbed Lin Meili's hands, restraining her whole body.

Lin Meili struggled desperately, clawing and pinching at the back of his hand.

Wang Chao was in pain and angry.

He freed up a hand and slapped her in the face.

Lin Meili was hit so hard that she turned her head away and her ears buzzed.

Before she could react, the second slap came down.

Then came the third slap.
